title: THC Cultivation Technician II
publicDescription: Demonstrates advanced cultivation technician capability in evidence-based troubleshooting, verification, documentation, traceability, process investigation, peer handoff, and integrated shift-level diagnostic work.
limitations: This Academy credential is educational and employment-oriented; it is not a government cannabis license or occupational license.
It does not authorize electrical, refrigerant, pesticide, chemical, product-disposition, supervisory, or management work beyond the holder's workplace authorization and applicable law.
Technician II supports and escalates decisions but does not replace Cultivation Lead or licensed/qualified trade authority where required.
